faq.title: Common questions
faq.description: Answers to the most common questions about our AI staff and websites.

q1.question: What type of businesses is this for?
q1.answer: Small and medium businesses, stores, service centers, auto parts shops, clinics, and organizations that frequently receive customer inquiries.

q2.question: Do I need technical knowledge?
q2.answer: No. We handle all configuration and installation. You only need simple admin access to edit your content.

q3.question: What does the monthly fee cover?
q3.answer: Servers, model usage, monitoring, knowledge updates and support are all included. The only extra is Eho's call minutes.

q4.question: Will an AI staff member replace my staff?
q4.answer: They take the daily load: repeat questions, bookings, reminders, reports. Anything delicate or unusual is handed to you. They do not replace people; they take the volume.

q5.question: What does Ara know, and what does she not?
q5.answer: Ara answers only from what you give her: prices, hours, services, terms. She never guesses; anything she does not know goes to you.

q6.question: How fast do they start?
q6.answer: AI staff within 3 to 5 days. A website within 7 to 10 working days.
